name: OM-2.0-200B-Base
description: Native OM decoder-only Transformer architecture target for distributed pretraining. Architecture preset only: NOT trained weights; cannot run/train on a Mac mini.
parameter_goal_note: The repository's ModelConfig estimator should report approximately 191.7B parameters. This is an architecture-only target, not a trained or validated model. Requires distributed multi-node GPU infrastructure, sharded optimizer states, high-bandwidth interconnect, very large licensed corpus, and extensive pretraining/post-training.
